title: Draught-affected Marathwada Region Relief

description:
In response to this crisis, an appeal was made to Chandulal Nanavati Women’s Institute and Girls High School led by Rtn Apurva Nanavati by Global Vikas Trust, led by Shri Mayank Gandhi, to support its drought relief efforts.

Nanavati School Trust has generously contributed ₹35 lakhs towards this noble cause. This contribution will help provide drinking water, food and ration kits to affected families in Beed district, support cattle through fodder camps, and strengthen long-term water security for farmers through water-harvesting and drip irrigation initiatives.
